english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for firm inner resolve to achieve or endure something.
Use this for firmness as resolve or determination rather than physical firmness.
Use 決心 for strong personal resolve, including the commitment behind a New Year's resolution.
Use this when the will means firm determination or a settled resolve to do something.

examples.english: I have the determination to get through these hardest days.
examples.traditional: 我有決心捱過呢段最辛苦嘅日子。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 kyut3 sam1 ngaai4 gwo3 ni1 dyun6 zeoi3 san1 fu2 ge3 jat6 zi2

examples.english: Their firmness was clear: they kept going no matter how hard it got.
examples.traditional: 佢落咗決心，無論幾辛苦都會行落去。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 lok6 zo2 kyut3 sam1 mou4 leon6 gei2 san1 fu2 dou1 wui5 haang4 lok6 heoi3

examples.english: I made a resolution to quit smoking this year.
examples.traditional: 我落定決心，今年一定要戒煙。
